videos.caption: I just wanted to bake chocolate lava cakes... Instead Evelyn cracked me, in more way than one. 🥀🍫😭 #househusbandbakes #evelynchevalier #evelynzzz #animecouplegoals #animetok  This recipe makes 4 chocolate lava cakes.  Ingredients:  • 1/2 cup (4 ounces) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the ramekins • 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting the ramekins • 6 ounces bittersweet or dark chocolate, chopped (about 1 cup plus 1 1/2 tablespoons) You can sub in chocolate chips if its all you have. • 2 large eggs, room temperature • 2 large egg yolks, room temperature • 1/4 cup granulated sugar • 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt Directions:  Gather the ingredients. ● Preheat oven to 450°F. Butter and lightly flour four 6-ounce ramekins. Tap out excess flour. Set the ramekins on a baking sheet. ● Fill a pan/pot with water to a depth of 1 or 2 Inches depending on the depth of the pot; bring to a boil over medium-high and reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a simmer. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium size heatproof bowl and set bowl over simmering water in pan, making sure bottom of bowl doesn't touch water. Cook over medium-low, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat as needed to maintain a simmer, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. ● Beat eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl with an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high speed until thickened and pale, 2 to 3 minutes ● Whisk melted chocolate until smooth ● Quickly fold melted chocolate mixture and flour into egg mixture in bowl until well combined and no streaks remain. ● Spoon batter into prepared ramekins (about 1/2 cup per ramekin) and smooth the top using a small offset spatula if needed. Place baking sheet with ramekins in the preheated oven; bake until tops of cakes are just set and edges spring back when touched but centers still feel soft, about 9 to 12 minutes. ● Remove cakes from oven and let cool in ramekins on baking sheet for 1 minute. Working with one ramekin at a time, cover ramekin with an inverted plate. Carefully turn over and let stand 10 seconds before lifting the ramekin to unmold cake. Repeat with remaining cakes. Dust with powdered sugar if you want the dominos pizza lavs cake look. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Microwave briefly to reheat.

Sweet. crunchy. chocolatey. And made with simple ingredients. If you love: Twix bars • chocolate desserts • healthy sweets • homemade candy bars • viral recipes this one is a must. ⸻ ✨ HOW TO MAKE HEALTHY TWIX BARS 1️⃣ Almond Cookie Base 🍪 Mix together: • 1 cup almond flour • 1 tbsp cornstarch • ¼ tsp sea salt • 2 tbsp coconut oil • 2 tbsp maple syrup • ½ tsp vanilla extract Press into a lined pan. ⸻ 2️⃣ Bake ✨ Bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 20 minutes until lightly golden. Let cool completely. ⸻ 3️⃣ Creamy Caramel Layer 🍯 Mix until smooth and creamy: • ¼ cup peanut butter • ¼ cup tahini • 2 tbsp coconut oil • 2 tbsp maple syrup Spread over the cookie base. ⸻ 4️⃣ Freeze & Slice ❄️ Freeze for 30 minutes, then cut into bars. ⸻ 5️⃣ Chocolate Coating 🍫 Dip each bar into melted dark chocolate and finish with: • fleur de sel Freeze again until the chocolate hardens perfectly. ⸻ Crunchy cookie.
